step_by_step_approach: Identify each team in the data set.
For each team, collect the total number of goals scored in each season.
Select the highest seasonal goal total for each team.
Gather all of those highest values into a single list.
Sort the list of highest values in ascending order.
Determine the middle value of the sorted list, or the average of the two middle values if the list has an even number of entries, to obtain the median.
